title: Correct acceleration calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the acceleration as 0.25 m/s² for part (1).

title: Correct terminal speed
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the constant ascent speed as 5 m/s for part (2).

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the equation F - mg - f = ma, correctly identifying all forces for the accelerating case.

title: Apply equilibrium condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the equation F - mg - f = 0 for the constant speed case, recognizing net force is zero.

title: Substitute air resistance correctly
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly substitute the given relation f = 40v into the force equations for both parts.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show unit analysis to verify the final answers have correct dimensions (m/s² and m/s).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns signs to forces (e.g., adding air resistance instead of subtracting).

title: Forgetting weight or buoyancy
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student omits either the weight (mg) or the buoyant force (F) in the force balance.
